# telnyx_advanced_number_order (Resource)

An advanced order for phone numbers, by country, type and features. Orders cannot be cancelled through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Orders cannot be cancelled through the API.
resource "telnyx_advanced_number_order" "example" {
  country_code      = "US"
  phone_number_type = "local"
  area_code         = "312"
  quantity          = 2
  features          = ["sms", "voice"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `area_code` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `customer_reference` (String)
- `features` (Set of String)
- `phone_number_type` (String) One of `landline`, `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `quantity` (Number)
- `requirement_group_id` (String) The ID of the requirement group associated with this advanced order

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `orders` (List of String)
- `status` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_advanced_number_order.example <id>
```
